input.scenario: primary mod requires B and C; both B and C require D

expected.reason: phase8-scope.md's own finding: the depth-3 cap alone does not prevent installing D twice for a genuinely non-cyclic diamond shape (A needs B and C, both need D) -- what actually prevents the duplicate download is the SAME already-installed checks (mod-ID match at line 295, filename-slug scan at line 297-299) that run before every recursive call, independent of the depth cap.
